Method of Attack: Steals bank credentials, Windows domain credentials, and provides remote access to threat actors who install ransomware
Infection via phishing emails utilizing Excel documents pretending to be DocSign documents
Use of Cobalt Strike pentesting tool to spread laterally through network while stealing unencrypted files and gathering admin credentials
Deployment of ransomware throughout Windows domain after gaining domain admin account access
Ransomware gang switching from ProLock to Egregor ransomware
Discoverer: Oleg Skulkin, Senior Digital Forensics Analyst at Group-IB
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Excel documents
Deployment through compromised domain admin accounts
